text: ●Front page of the passport (The passport must be valid for 6 months from the date of submitting the application); ●High school or equivalent degree certificate and transcript, or transcripts for A-Level/IB/AP and other courses; ●HSK certificate (for non-Chinese descendants) ●Certificate of No Criminal Record (can be accompanied by a signed commitment letter of no criminal record from the school, see Appendix 4); ●Financial guarantee letter (a bank deposit certificate can be provided, with the amount sufficient to cover the tuition and living expenses during the study in China; or relevant proof of movable or immovable property can be provided; a financial guarantee letter can be signed with the school, see Appendix 5); ●Payment voucher for the registration fee or screenshot of online payment; ●Electronic photos
